sql: SELECT n1.id, e1.id, n1.props FROM (SELECT 'a6aa67a9-a09f-4b90-87d2-b404400d176d' AS id, 1 AS ord) AS f0 LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = 'Profile' OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = 'Profile')))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = 'Profile' OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = 'Profile')))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = 'Profile' OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = 'Profile')) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
